subject: Privileged inventory & evidence: SCIM/SAML extracts and service account mapping
messages:
From: Julia Park <julia.park@novahealth.com>
To: rachel.kim@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Access inventory and SCIM/SAML evidence request (SOC 2 intake)

Hi Rachel,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. As part of NovaHealth's SOC 2 intake we need to collect a compact evidence bundle for access control covering the last 90 days. Specifically we need the following by close of business Tuesday (2026-05-25):

- SCIM delta export for the tenant (user joins/leaves, role assignments) covering 2026-03-22 -> 2026-05-22 (CSV or JSON).
- A sample set of SAML assertion logs (redacted) demonstrating attribute mappings and audience/recipient values for normal login flows.
- Inventory of service accounts/service principals that have elevated roles (owner/roles with write permissions), including owner contact and justification.
- A short narrative (1 page) for how least-privilege is enforced for service accounts and ephemeral admin sessions.

We have attached our questionnaire (nova_compliance_questionnaire.xlsx) with preferred file formats and an example CSV schema. If you can ACK this request and share an ETA that would be great — we can accept a partial delivery (SCIM + SAML snippets first, inventory next).

If you prefer a short stand-up to coordinate, Julia and I are available early Monday.

Thanks,
Julia Park
Sr. Security Compliance Manager
NovaHealth

Attachments: nova_compliance_questionnaire.xlsx (Excel spreadsheet, 120KB)

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Julia Park <julia.park@novahealth.com>, compliance@novahealth.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-22T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Access inventory and SCIM/SAML evidence request (SOC 2 intake)

Julia — thanks for the clear list. We can meet your timeline. Plan:

1) Today (EOD): ACK and provide SCIM delta extract + 5 SAML assertion samples (redacted) as CSV/TXT.
2) Monday: service-account inventory PDF with owner/contact and justification; one-page narrative on least-privilege controls.
3) Tuesday (if needed): supplemental logs or clarifications after your review.

Marissa and Ben — looping you both in to pull the SCIM delta and assertion snippets and to redaction-check.

Deliverables we'll attach/link: scim-delta-20260322-20260522.csv, saml-assertions-samples.txt, service-account-inventory-20260522.pdf, and a short narrative PDF. I will provide signed Drive links for any files containing PII.

Julia — rough ETA is: SCIM+SAML samples by 2026-05-22 17:00 PDT; full inventory and narrative by 2026-05-25 COB. Does that work?

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Account Manager, Security Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments (planned): scim-delta-20260322-20260522.csv (CSV stub), saml-assertions-samples.txt (log snippets), service-account-inventory-20260522.pdf (PDF stub)

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-24T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: INBOX: NovaHealth SOC2 evidence — SCIM delta, SAML samples, service-account inventory (action items)

Hi team — routing NovaHealth's intake here. Summary / asks:

- SCIM delta: full CSV covering 2026-03-22 -> 2026-05-22. Columns: timestamp, action (add/remove/update), user_email, user_id, prior_roles, new_roles, source (SCIM/API). Please redact emails to username@redacted if the file will transit external storage; we'll provide signed link for delivery.
- SAML assertions: provide 5 assertion snippets for successful logins (include NameID format, attributes, audience, recipient). Redact any PII and include a short note explaining how attributes are mapped to RBAC roles.
- Service-account inventory: export of service principals and machine accounts with assigned roles and last-used timestamp, primary owner, and justification (one line). Produce as PDF or CSV. Flag any accounts with Owner or Editor-level permissions.

Timeline: SCIM+SAML samples are high priority — NovaHealth expects an initial drop by 2026-05-22 EOD; we missed that slot, so please target EOD 2026-05-25 for the initial artifacts and 2026-05-27 for the completed inventory + narrative.

Notes on redaction: do not include full employee PII in public links. If you need to include full emails for traceability, encrypt or share via the secure Drive link and tell me which fields remained unredacted.

Marissa — can you pull the SCIM delta and scrub per above? Ben — can you extract the SAML assertion snippets and add the RBAC mapping note? I will assemble the PDF inventory and coordinate delivery with the NovaHealth mailbox.

Thanks — Rachel

--
Rachel Kim
Account Manager, Security Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: scim-delta-20260322-20260522.csv (to be generated), saml-assertions-samples.txt (to be generated), service-account-inventory-20260522.pdf (to be assembled)
